name: Kongsberg Maritime ASA
summary: Kongsberg Maritime ASA, along with its subsidiaries, delivers a comprehensive suite of products and integrated systems crucial for positioning, navigation, marine automation, and safety management. These solutions are vital for onshore and offshore installations, as well as the commercial shipping industry. Their extensive product range encompasses sophisticated bridge, camera, and deck systems, advanced engine room and automation technologies, and critical information and safety platforms. The company also provides specialized naval and onshore systems, a broad selection of sensors and transmitters, state-of-the-art simulators, cutting-edge subsea technology, and precise tank gauging and measurement tools. Further offerings include autonomous underwater vehicles (AUVs), specialized marine technology handling systems, and advanced sonar equipment for comprehensive seabed surveys. Kongsberg Maritime's underwater acoustic portfolio features diverse imaging and profiling sonars (both mechanically scanned and multibeam), multibeam echo sounders, and altimeters, alongside systems for subsea gas measurement and environmental monitoring. They also supply precision marine electronics, such as high-accuracy positioning and motion sensing units, and comprehensive fish-finding equipment, including fishery sonars, echo sounders, and net instrumentation. Beyond product development, the company provides a wide array of services, including cargo handling solutions, subsea survey and construction support, maritime simulation and professional training programs, and satellite-based positioning, among other specialized maritime and oil & gas related solutions. Their expertise extends to electro-instrumentation and telecommunications engineering, seamless system integration, and comprehensive engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) contracting. They offer robust project and site management services, alongside engineering and simulation-based training for heavy equipment operators, product rental, and ongoing product training and support. Established in 1814, Kongsberg Maritime operates globally from its headquarters in Kongsberg, Norway, supported by numerous international offices. They serve a diverse clientele across the defense, maritime, oil and gas, and aerospace industries and maintain a strategic alliance with Huntington Ingalls Industries.
